thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: reserved_pool_throttle for tenant=solari-prod (dedicated-cluster solari-d1)

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-8342 created and notified oncall schedule (severity: high)

maria: acked. I'm on it, pulling metrics now.

josh: seeing 95th latency spike on solari routes, errors creeping to ~7%  — looks like KV cache fallback + burst queueing.

irina: can you paste the alert lines?

josh: https://metrics/redwood/solari-prod/alerts ->
```
reserved_pool_throttle{tenant="solari-prod"} 1
p95_latency_route{route="/v1/generate",tenant="solari-prod"} 1.27
error_rate_5m{tenant="solari-prod"} 0.072
queue_depth{cluster="solari-d1"} 89
```

samira: customer Slack says they see degraded inference and timeouts on heavy requests  — their UI retries are amplifying load. CC @maria

maria: thanks. initial hypothesis: dedicated pool is hitting soft throttle because background batch warmups plus a few large-seq jobs caused KV cache misses and swap to slow path. autoscaler didn't kick due to policy min=2 nodes.

josh: running `rtxctl cluster inspect solari-d1` — nodes all at ~92% GPU util, one pod OOM'd earlier and got restarted.

opsbot: Suggested mitigations: 1) Temporary tenant-rate-limit fallback 2) Scale up reserved pool by +1 GPU node 3) Route large-seq requests to cheaper model variant 4) Warmup KV cache for hot prefixes.

maria: doing 1 & 2 now. Applying tenant soft-rate-limit 0.8 RPS per shard to cut retries.

josh: command:
```
redwoodctl tenant update-rate solari-prod --burst=20 --rate=0.8
redwoodctl cluster scale solari-d1 --replicas=3
```

maria: executed both. cluster scaling requested, should finish in ~45s. Rate limit applied.

irina: I've opened a canary rule to route `/v1/generate` requests with seq>1024 to fallback-model-8q to reduce KV pressure.

samira: noted. telling customer we've applied protective limits and scaled. asking for sample request IDs to correlate.

pagerduty: escalation: not yet. waiting 10m after mitigations for stability.

josh: tailing logs: a steady drop in error rate from 7% -> 3.5% after rate limit. p95 latency down to 0.9s. queue depth falling.

maria: cluster scaled to 3 replicas and new nodes joined. KV cache miss rate trending down after warmup triggered.

opsbot: Reminder: set temporary alert suppression for PD noise: suppress reserved_pool_throttle for solari-prod for 30m.

maria: suppressing alert window for 30m.

irina: customer provided request IDs; correlated; a handful of large-batch jobs still hitting slow path. Suggest drafting guidance: avoid concurrent >16 long sequences, or use background async job route.

samira: I'll send them an incident update: summary + action items + ETA for postmortem.

maria: handing off to josh for watch. I'm going offline in 35m; if things degrade, escalate to SRE lead.

josh: got it, I'll remain on watch. setting local dashboard refresh to 15s.

pagerduty: If errors rise above 5% again, auto-escalate to EMs.

josh: for follow-up — we should consider raising autoscaler minimum for solari-d1 or add warmup prefetch during traffic bursts. Filing a ticket after incident.

samira: customer acknowledgement: "Thanks, service looks better now. We'll throttle our heavy jobs for the next hour."

maria: :thumbsup: good. final status in 30m unless regressions.

josh: last check: p95=0.72s, error_rate=1.6%, cluster GPU util=68%. closing immediate page.

maria: handing to next oncall (irina) for the 1hr observation window. Irina - please escalate if anything reappears.

irina: taking it. all good so far. will update in 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread closed by oncall after mitigations applied (notes saved to PD-8342).
